create.$comment: Derived from Core 6b133551f03fe48130b8bf9974f77b19c614271c. Native v2 additionally limits enrollment IDs to 128 characters. Core validates enrollment and merged semantics.
create.description: A request to create a new runner.

id.description: The unique identifier for the runner under the organization.
id.x-pattern-error: id must be a valid identifier

description.description: An optional text description for this runner.

runner_configuration.description: A runtime-independent native pool registration. Create requires approved inventory, capabilities and v2 pipeline protocols. Responses preserve absence after explicit clears. The public key, capacity and registration identity remain retained; metadata alone does not activate execution.

key.description: A public ed25519 key in PEM format. The caller must hold the matching private key.
key.x-pattern-error: key: does not look like an ed25519 public key in PEM format

max_parallel_jobs.description: Explicit admission limit for the logical native pool. There is no unlimited native default. Updating this limit does not stop already admitted work.

supported_protocols.description: Create requires stellwerk.pipeline/v2 and stellwerk.pipeline.plan-apply/v2. Their legacy v1 variants are forbidden. This field may be absent after clearing a disabled registration.

native_execution.description: Operator-approved public inventory. The digest binds private local configuration and executable bytes; it cannot be reconstructed from this projection. This metadata does not enroll a site or enable native execution by itself.

items.description: Public metadata for one installed approved tool. Contains no executable, environment, credential or local path.

state_storage_configuration.description: Configuration for the Terraform Backend used by the runner.

oneOf.description: Configuration to use the Kubernetes Backend as backend of this runner. The in-cluster mode is used.

namespace.description: Where the secrets with the state should be created.

oneOf.description:
Configuration to use an AWS S3 bucket as state storage backend of this runner. Authentication and other settings
can be set via environment variables and defaults. See <https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/backend/s3#state-storage>
for more details.

bucket.x-pattern-error: state storage bucket is not a valid S3 Bucket name.

path_prefix.description: A prefix path for the state file. The environment uuid will be used as a unique key within this.
path_prefix.x-pattern-error: state storage path_prefix is not a valid S3 prefix path.

oneOf.description:
Configuration to use a Google Cloud Storage (GCS) bucket as state storage backend of this runner. Authentication and other settings
can be set via environment variables and defaults. See <https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/backend/gcs#state-storage>
for more details.

bucket.x-pattern-error: state storage bucket is not a valid GCS Bucket name.

path_prefix.description: A prefix path for the state file. The environment uuid will be used as a unique key within this.
path_prefix.x-pattern-error: state storage path_prefix is not a valid GCS prefix path.

oneOf.description:
Configuration to use an AzureRM Storage Account as state storage backend of this runner. Authentication and other settings
can be set via environment variables and defaults. See <https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/backend/azurerm#state-storage>

resource_group_name.description: Name of the Azure Resource Group.

storage_account_name.description: Name of the Azure Storage Account.

container_name.description: Name of the Azure Storage Container.

path_prefix.description: A prefix path for the state file. The environment uuid will be used as a unique key within this.
path_prefix.x-pattern-error: state storage path_prefix is not a valid AzureRM path.
